title: Every step deferred on you has a question waiting for you
why: Finding, Oct 27 (iOS kit consultation): c47 part 2 needed your plan check, but no thread ever asked you; you asked "is the plan waiting for me in another session", and it was not.
note: 12 open steps carry a Deferred line (roadmap 11ebfe16). The waiting page (c71) only holds what a session puts there, so a step deferred on you can sit with no question at all. Fix, needs no answer: build.py's upkeep list counts deferred steps that need you and name no question (a waiting-page item or a decision card), and triage raises each one; the note names where the question sits. Port: no; the roadmap lives in claude-settings. Placed after c86, ahead of c93 (triage, Oct 27): a deferred step with no question stalls forever.
